claim: The default quota is 5 egress-only internet gateways per Region; to raise it, raise the quota for VPCs per Region. Only one egress-only internet gateway can be attached to a VPC at a time.
question: How many egress-only internet gateways can an account have per Region, and how many per VPC?

values.spoken: five egress-only internet gateways per Region

values.display: only one egress-only internet gateway to a VPC at a time
values.spoken: one per VPC at a time

qualifiers.condition: raised through the VPCs per Region quota
